react_native_issues.issue: Console error on the public booking screen: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' — a raw text/whitespace is rendered directly inside a <View> instead of within <Text>. Non-blocking (UI still displays), but should be fixed to avoid warnings and potential native crashes. Reference: /app/frontend/app/book/[slug]/[id].tsx (Suppléments block around lines 220-270).

Recurring warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Multiple StyleSheets, incl. /app/frontend/app/settings/supplements.tsx:109 (FAB) and /app/frontend/app/supplement-form.tsx via shared theme.
Warning during login: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: shared login component.

action_items: Fix the 'Unexpected text node' console error on the public booking page — inspect /app/frontend/app/book/[slug]/[id].tsx around the Suppléments section (extra whitespace/newline rendered directly inside a <View>, or a conditional producing a bare string). Wrap any stray text in <Text> or remove the whitespace expression.
Optional cleanup: migrate remaining shadow* style props to unified 'boxShadow' (already tracked in previous iterations).
Optional cleanup: replace React 'pointerEvents' prop with style.pointerEvents on affected component.

book/[slug]/[id].tsx: sup-toggle-<id> present in Suppléments block. However, a raw text node inside a <View> triggers a Unexpected text node warning — see action item.
